annotations.title: Tell the Atlas where to read your site

description: For a proved owner: name the pricing page, the careers page and the changelog or release notes, on your own domain. The Atlas reads them with its usual readers and guards - a price must be printed on the page, a job board must be your own, release notes must carry dates - and never takes a figure on your word. A new pricing page is read within the hour; careers and releases on the next read (atlas_owner_remeasure). Send all three each time: an omitted one is cleared. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

careersUrl.description: Your careers page, or your board on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby or Workable

changelogUrl.description: Changelog, release notes or what's new, with dated entries

domain.description: The tool's domain as the Atlas lists it, e.g. acme.ai
